recipeNotes: Guest reads, rendered HTML pages, feeds/sitemap, then an authenticated write path — every path taken from the route tables (src/routes/*). The mocha suite was NOT used: it boots its own server in-process, so it would be a different process tree, not this one.

phases.name: common
phases.detail: guest JSON API + the core rendered pages

phases.name: full
phases.detail: feeds, sitemap, search, write API v3 (login → create topic → reply → tag), admin JSON
